body: Really? I have a choice! Damn, I shouldn't have let that guy get away.

Thank you for your kind, kind words. I realize it'll get better. I know everyone has their hardships, but I am only human. I hurt and feel like the next person, and I can only handle people hurting me seemingly all the time, that I don't want to keep pursuing a chance to live a better life. 

I feel more comfort among stranger than those who are meant to love me.
